Living in an orphanage, Tong Yexun has always been a child who never got along well with others. One day, Tong Yexun, gets bullied, hiding in a corner, alone and wiping away at her tears. The tears dripped on onto one of Tong's drawing papers, becoming wet. description.en: Seo Yeon-woo earns a living by playing games, and in the hidden quest game he’s been given, he struggled for several months and received fragments of a cube as a reward. What are these cube fragments used for? Are these scammers? Give me back the time I’ve wasted! But something amazing happened when the cube came into my hands. “You have become the owner of the ancient magical weapon ‘Kigantes Dark’.” Is this my turning point in life? Did I hit the jackpot? This is the story of Seo Yeon-woo, a survival-type gamer, and his adventure with the ancient weapon, Kigantes Dark!

A small story about Xiaofei and the section chief before they became a couple.  
Prequel to [Day Off](https://mangadex.org/title/47340/day-off).

description.en: One day, she woke up, and four years later had passed. Not only did she become the contractual wife of the cold-faced tyrant Huo Yicheng, but she was also the human ATM for her stepmother and stepsister. Such injustice! After Shen Yunxi dealt with the other woman, she found out it was him who lied to her the most..
《Fluffy》 is a serialized webcomic written by Yang Xiaoru. The comic tells of a rainy night, when the stray dog taken home by a girl, turned into a boy with shaggy hair.

altTitles.zh: 开局满仇恨，我靠嘲讽升级成神

description.en: The countless martial artists were gnashing their teeth at Xia Ping, wanting to bury him in the ground. Xia Ping, in response to the hatred of so many people, calmly pulled forth the “Super hatred System” interface and looked at the various goodies on it, rubbing his chin: “I’ve accumulated so many values, I don’t know whether to exchange for the Sacred Pill Chaos Pill, or the supreme martial art Rulai Palm, or the divine weapon Qiankun Cauldron, what a worry. “
description.zh: 炎黄星无数武道强者对夏平咬牙切齿，简直恨不得将其挫骨扬灰。而夏平面对这么多人的仇恨，淡定的拉出“超级系统”界面，看着上面各种好东西，摸了摸下巴：“都积攒到这么多数值了，不知道是兑换圣品丹药混沌丹，还是绝世武学如来掌，或者是神器乾坤鼎，真是烦恼啊。”

description.en: A young man who became a wrestling champion died soon after because he saved a girl from suicide. By a miracle, he wakes up in a hospital, but he is stuck in that girl's body. Now he has to take his wrestling career back and deal with all the girl problems that get in the way

altTitles.zh-ro: Gou Zai Nv Mo Tou Shen Bian
Gǒu Zài Nǚ Mó Tóu Shēn Biān

description.en: Jiang Hao isekai-ed into an ordinary peasant’s family, and was sold into the Demonic Sect and forced to become a disciple. He wanted to cultivate in peace and build his strength steadily, in order to survive in this Cultivation-based world. But, he instead was humiliated in every possible manner by a Demoness. The difference in their strength was overwhelming, and so he could only endure the humiliation in order to preserve his life. Without the help of a backer, Jiang Hao gained the favor of the Demonic Sect and was finally able to cultivate in peace. When he became the chief disciple and met with the Sect leader however, he looked at the other party’s supremely beautiful face and didn’t know whether to laugh or to cry…
description.zh: 江浩穿越普通人家，被迫卖入魔门，成为魔门弟子。 本想安心修炼一点点变强，好在修真界生存下去，可却被一位女魔头“百般羞辱”。 实力相差悬殊，他只能忍辱偷生。 没有靠山的他得到了魔门掌教的青睐，得以安心修炼，当他成为首席弟子面见掌教时， 望着对方绝美的脸庞，他有些笑不出来......

description.en: In the peak of the Tang Dynasty, Suzhou's wealthiest family, the Jia Family's precious daughter enjoys dressing as a boy. She dresses as a boy every day, pretending to be the second young master of the Jia Family as she runs about town with her two bodyguards causing trouble. With her acts of exacting justice on behalf of women, she is liked by all the women in the city and solidly holds the title of "National Husband". In fact, the amount of proposals that have come to the door have nearly flattened the entrance floorboards of the Jia Family mansion! On the contrary, when men see her in her own form, they are all fearful of her. All men run in the opposite direction as soon as they see her, none dare to cross this little lord, that is except for one...

description.en: Transmigrating into a 1v5 bloody carnage novel as the female lead, Mu Haohao has a meltdown. Something about how everyone has to be in perfect harmony before she can return to the real world, she can't do it at all! Originally, she chooses to force an escape from the plot, but who knew she actually reincarnated upon opening her eyes?! She then decides to bite the bullet and play the game of harmony, but finds out the five male leads have all reincarnated still holding memories from their previous life...
description.vi:
Bỗng dưng xuyên vào một truyện ngôn tình 1 nữ 5 nam đầy kịch tính, nữ chính Mộ Hảo Hảo chỉ biết tuyệt vọng. Muốn trở về thế giới thật thì phải “toàn员 hòa hợp” ư? Cô hoàn toàn không làm nổi!

Cô quyết định cưỡng chế rời khỏi cốt truyện, ai ngờ vừa nhắm mắt mở mắt đã… trọng sinh!?

Tưởng rằng sẽ phải cắn răng tiếp tục chơi trò “nữ hoàng hậu cung”, nhưng bất ngờ phát hiện: cả năm nam chính đều mang ký ức kiếp trước quay lại cùng cô…
